steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: The Greek Underworld (Hades) was the realm of the dead, ruled by the god Hades and his queen Persephone | Key Fact: All souls went to the Underworld — it was not simply a place of reward or punishment | Key Fact: Charon the ferryman transported souls across the River Styx — the dead were buried with a coin for payment | Key Fact: The Underworld had distinct regions: Asphodel Meadows for ordinary souls, Elysium for heroes, and Tartarus for the wicked
